resultats_lens.titre: PROTECTING BARLEY AT T2 WITH ARIZONA® | ADAMA

brut.title: PROTECTING BARLEY AT T2 WITH ARIZONA® | ADAMA

webpage.text:
PROTECTING BARLEY AT T2 WITH ARIZONA®

The T2 spray window (GS39-59) is the main opportunity for growers to protect crops against ramularia and to provide continued protection against net blotch and rhynchosporium - according to the AHDB, approximately 40% of fungicide yield response comes from this timing. It is therefore the ideal opportunity to include the multi-site fungicide, ARIZONA® (500g/l folpet) as a tank mix partner to triazoles such as Revysol which has, in recent years, become the backbone of barley fungicide programmes.

The addition of ARIZONA® at T2 provides a distinct improvement in ramularia control and extends green leaf area duration resulting in better crop yields and improved grain quality.

The addition of ARIZONA® also plays an important role in resistance management: there is increasing concern for the continued development of ramularia and net blotch resistance to at-risk single site chemistries including even the most recently introduced and highly effective products such as adepidyn. Including ARIZONA® in mixture with products such as this will extend the effective lifetime of this important SDHI fungicide against both ramularia and net blotch.


Why add ARIZONA®?

Including ARIZONA® (500g/l folpet) at the T2 timing provides five clear benefits:

 * Enhances disease control by providing additional activity against ramularia, net blotch and rhynchosporium
 * Works with partner products (including triazole) to provide long-lasting protection
 * Delivers a reliable return on investment by extending green leaf area duration, resulting in higher yields and improved grain quality
 * ADAMA’s ARIZONA® is the only multi-site fungicide which has been proven to extend the effective lifetime of at-risk single site fungicides by delaying the development of resistance
 * ARIZONA® enhances septoria control in wheat and can also provide a useful reduction of yellow and brown rusts. It also offers intrinsic activity against mildew.
 * ARIZONA® also safeguards barley against ramularia, net blotch and rhynchosporium.
 * T2 is the key timing for the inclusion of ARIZONA® in barley programmes


Improved disease control = better yields

As the charts below illustrate, the inclusion of ARIZONA® as a tank mix partner with other chemistries enhances disease control, resulting in better yields.
